name: Polylink Polymers (India) Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1993, Polylink Polymers Ltd manufactures and sells polymeric compounds and color masterbatches
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
Company manufactures various compounds of Power cable, Telephone cable and Engineering Plastics. Company also started production of Black, Color Master Batch and pigments

cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Company has a low return on equity of 5.49% over last 3 years.
